title: Aetherium
description: Aetherium is a modpack that you can use to make Minecraft more beautiful.
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9fe20f1f6dae676c3a325e35df680257aca9ed6_0.webp)

Aetherium is a modpack that you can use to make Minecraft more beautiful. Among other things, it includes several famous shaders like BSL and Bliss, dozens of mods like BetterEnd and texture packs to make the game more enjoyable. For easier multiplayer, I have also added the Essential mod to the modpack. Discover new dimensions like Aether and Sculk dimension. Enjoy the game!
